id: title:DanielVisca:use locked dependencies for nextest source installs

observations.behavior: Adds a '--locked' argument to the Cargo binstall command for installing cargo-nextest.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes CI behavior; this could prevent version mismatch or dependency resolution issues during Rust-dependent builds.

observations.limitations: Only one hunk is provided; it does not demonstrate broader systemic benefit or risk reduction.
